title: Aura Studio project file
description: Schema for a .aura project file, schema versions 2 to 5 (the /rc/ build reads and writes up to 5). The top level is human-readable; nested arrays (mixer, effects, patterns, accents, melodies) stay positional for size and are documented field by field in AURA_PROJECT_SCHEMA.md beside this file. Unknown fields are allowed: Aura ignores keys it does not know.

schemaVersion.description: The lowest reader version that can open the file without losing anything: 2 base, 3 with any of lowEnd, variations, performance, groove, lyrics, intention or a drawn energy curve, 4 with vocal takes inside, 5 with a section's own Warmth (project.energy.w). A reader refuses a number above the one it knows.

appVersion.description: Semantic version of the Aura build that wrote the file (e.g. "13.9.0-rc.2"). Informational.

projectId.description: Stable identity: a UUID (crypto.randomUUID) where available, otherwise an aura_ id.

createdAt.description: ISO-8601; set once when the project id is minted.

capabilities.description: What this build of Aura supports: an object of booleans, so new capabilities are added explicitly.

mediaPersistence.description: What THIS file embeds. Vocal takes are embedded (16-bit WAV) only when the project has them; imported audio never is.

content.description: What is actually in this project, computed from state. Symmetrical with capabilities.

encoding.description: Human note on how the compact nested arrays are laid out, plus schemaRef (this file's name).

media.description: Present only when the file carries vocal takes (schemaVersion 4 or more).

mask.description: 16-bit step bitmask; bit s (1<<s) marks step s active, 16 steps.

slot.description: Arrangement slot: a section index 0-5, or null for an empty bar.

drumRow.description: One section of accents: 6 drum masks [kick,snare,clap,hat,openhat,shaker].

track.description: The vocal track: vocals (Lead), double or harmony.

channels.description: New takes are mono; old stereo takes still open.

head.description: Seconds of the take before the song's start.

clips.description: The take's clips on the timeline.

wav.description: The take as a base64 16-bit WAV.

t.description: The drawn target curve, one value a bar (0-100).

p.description: Per section index: its Shape values [intensity, warmth, movement, space]. The warmth slot is not read since 13.9.0-rc.2 (see w).

s.description: Song-wide [warmth, room, echo]. Room and echo have no control since 13.9.0-rc.2 and are kept as written.

w.description: Per section index: that section's own Warmth, only where it differs from s[0]. Present means schemaVersion 5.

melodies.description: Exactly 6 sections; each a list of note tuples.

lowEnd.description: Per section: the editable low-end reconstruction (schema 3).

variations.description: Alternate versions of the song: activeId, main, items (schema 3).

performance.description: Recorded performance events and whether they play: events, enabled (schema 3).

groove.description: The groove controls c, seed s, and source sf (schema 3 when changed from the defaults).

lyrics.description: The singer's words: t (text per section) and n (notes per section). Text only (schema 3 when present).

intention.description: The project intention: what this record is trying to be (schema 3 when any field is set).
